dialogues.jp:
ざわめく教室で、椅子の背もたれによりかかり、
雑誌を読みふける。
dialogues.en:
In the noisy classroom, I kicked back into my chair and read
a magazine.
dialogues.text:
In the noisy classroom, I kicked back into my chair and read
a magazine.

dialogues.jp: このクラス以外はひっそりと静まり返っている。
dialogues.en: The class was a stark contrast from the rest of the school.
dialogues.text: The class was a stark contrast from the rest of the school.

dialogues.jp: （和久井の授業は自習が多いから救われる）
dialogues.en:
"(When Wakui declares a self-study lesson, everyone
rejoices.)"
dialogues.text:
"(When Wakui declares a self-study lesson, everyone
rejoices.)"

dialogues.jp:
授業そっちのけで研究に励む和久井が、テスト
が終わったこの時期に、授業などするはずがな
い。
dialogues.en:
Wakui is more of a researcher than a teacher at heart, so
when the tests were over, both parties didn't want to
continue with lessons.
dialogues.text:
Wakui is more of a researcher than a teacher at heart, so
when the tests were over, both parties didn't want to
continue with lessons.

dialogues.jp:
真面目に自習をしている音夢が、ときどき振り
返り、雑誌を読んでいる俺を｛にら／睨｝むが、席を立つ
ことはない。
dialogues.en:
Nemu, actually doing self-study, took a look back at myself
reading a magazine, shook her head in disgust, and turned
her head back.
dialogues.text:
Nemu, actually doing self-study, took a look back at myself
reading a magazine, shook her head in disgust, and turned
her head back.

dialogues.jp: 俺は工藤から借りた次の雑誌に手を伸ばした。
dialogues.en:
I stuck out my hand towards Kudou to borrow another
magazine.
dialogues.text:
I stuck out my hand towards Kudou to borrow another
magazine.

dialogues.jp:
試験も終って、もともと自分の研究命の和久井
が授業なんぞをするはずもなく、俺は音夢の｛にら／睨｝
みを無視しつつ、工藤に借りた雑誌を読んだ。
dialogues.en:
With no exams to worry about, Wakui declared the class to be
a self-study one in order to further his own research. Kudou
and I exchanged magazines, and Nemu and I exchanged glares.
dialogues.text:
With no exams to worry about, Wakui declared the class to be
a self-study one in order to further his own research. Kudou
and I exchanged magazines, and Nemu and I exchanged glares.
